Spirit Award Now Available at ScoutShop

# International Spirit Award Now Available at ScoutShop

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/International-Spirit-
Award-BSA-300x240.jpg)

The International Spirit Award can now be purchased through the Scout Shop on-
line [here, ](https://www.scoutshop.org/international-spirit-award-
emblem-659814.html)as well as at your local Scout Shop. Previously,
International Spirit Awards were processed by the BSA International Department
at the BSA National Office.

Going forward, **Youth International Spirit Awards** will be processed consistent with Youth advancement procedure through Scoutbook/Internet Advancement [Scoutbook | Boy Scouts of America.](https://www.scouting.org/resources/scoutbook/) Please note, this is a restricted item only available at Scoutshop.org or through your local council Scout Shop with required paperwork.

Going forward, **Adult Awards** will be processed through your local Council
International Representative (Council lead international Scouting volunteer)
and Council Registrar. Please note, this is a restricted item only available
at Scoutshop.org or through your local council Scout Shop with required
paperwork.

 The International Spirit Award seeks to broaden knowledge of International
Scouting and increase appreciation and awareness of cultures and countries,
and it helps Scouts understand that they are members of a worldwide movement
of fellow scouts.

Through this award, Scouts and Scouters will have an opportunity to learn
about the World Organization of the Scout Movement (WOSM), have the
opportunity to engage with world scouting in their Unit and local Council
program, and engage with scouts from around the globe.

The International Spirit Award is available for Cub Scouts, Scouts BSA, Sea
Scouts, Venturers and Scouters. We encourage earning this award as a shared
Unit activity among Youth and Adult Leaders. We recommend Unit leaders contact
their Council International Representative for guidance and assistance on how
to earn the award and lead their Unit in achieving this award.

The International Spirit Award is available for Scouters, Cub Scouts, Scouts
BSA, Sea Scouts, and Venturers. Requirements and Award form can be found
[h](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/International-Spirit-
Award-app.130-044-Rev.-June-2021-2.pdf)[ere](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2020/02/International-Spirit-Award-
app.130-044-Rev.-June-2021-2.pdf). Fill out the application with the date that
each requirement was completed. All requirements must be met within 5 years
from the start to completion of the Award.

For adult leaders and youth, the [International Spirit
Award](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/International-
Spirit-Award-app.130-044-Rev.-June-2021-3.pdf) emblem is worn as a temporary
patch centered on the right uniform pocket.



**International Adventure Awaits…**

Scouting is happening all around the world [World Scouting
|](https://www.scout.org/) National Scout Organizations represent their home
countries and deliver the promise of Scouting in virtually all areas and
regions globally. The BSA International Department works to help Scouts and
Leaders from the BSA to experience the bigger picture of Scouting and connect
with it through our involvement in the World Organization of the Scout
Movement.
